intro.text: A highborn lady, wife of Lord Peterus.

items.text: Marthin and her husband Peterus were guests at the Yomen-Ostlin wedding dinner. When the Vanishers attacked, she urged him to stay quiet and seated rather than challenge them, but he ignored her.

After one of the Vanishers struck Peterus on the head to silence him, Marthin pressed a napkin to the wound. When the gang tried to take Steris and Marasi, Peterus left her side again and was shot dead by the same man.

personality.text: Cautious, perhaps fearful; she wanted her husband to avoid provoking the Vanishers.
